sourceCode: _pretenured_withIndexDo: elementAndIndexBlock   "Just like do: except that the iteration index supplies the second argument to the block"   "(Array streamContents: [:stream| #(11 22 13) withIndexDo: [ :each :i | stream nextPut: (each * each + i)]]) >>> #(122 486 172)"   1 to: self size do: [ :index |   elementAndIndexBlock value: (self at: index) value: index ]
_pretenured_readStreamEncoded: anEncoding   ^ ZnCharacterReadStream        _pretenured_on: self binaryReadStream        encoding: anEncoding

_pretenured_newForEncoding: string   "Return a new character encoder object for an encoding described by string.	Search for a subclass that handles it and delegate (subclassResponsibility)."   | concreteSubclass |   concreteSubclass := self _pretenured_allSubclasses                          detect: [ :each |                          each handlesEncoding: string ]                          ifNone: [ ^ self default ].   ^ concreteSubclass newForEncoding: string

_pretenured_readFromInternal: aFileReference   "Read data frame from a CSV file"   | stream reader df |   stream := aFileReference _pretenured_readStream.   reader := NeoCSVReader on: stream.   reader separator: self separator.   self readColumnNamesWith: reader.   self readRowsWith: reader.   reader close.   df := self _pretenured_createDataFrame.   ^ df

_pretenured_allSubclasses   "Answer an orderedCollection of the receiver's and the receiver's descendent's subclasses. "   <reflection:   'Class structural inspection - Iterating and querying hierarchy'>   | scan scanTop |   scan := OrderedCollection withAll: self subclasses.   scanTop := 1.   [ scanTop > scan size ] whileFalse: [         scan addAll: (scan at: scanTop) _pretenured_subclasses.         scanTop := scanTop + 1 ].   ^ scan
_pretenured_initializeRows: anArrayOfArrays   contents := DataFrameInternal withRows: anArrayOfArrays.   self setDefaultRowColumnNames.   self _pretenured_calculateDataTypes

_pretenured_asZnCharacterEncoder   "Return a ZnCharacterEncoder instance using the receiver as identifier"   " 'UTF-8' asZnCharacterEncoder "   ^ ZnCharacterEncoder _pretenured_newForEncoding: self
_pretenured_encoding: encoding   encoder := encoding _pretenured_asZnCharacterEncoder

_pretenured_cull: anArg   "Execute the receiver with one or zero arguments depending on the receiver"   "([ 12 ] cull: 13)>>> 12 "   "([:x | x + 12] cull: 3)>>> 15"   <reflection:   'Message sending and code execution - Runtime and Evaluation'>   ^ numArgs = 0        ifTrue: [ self value ]        ifFalse: [ self value: anArg ]

_pretenured_growAtLast   "Add new empty slots to the end of array, while keeping the empty slots at the front."   "OrderedCollection new capacity >>> 10"   "(OrderedCollection new growAtLast; capacity) >>> 20"   | newArray |   newArray := self class arrayType newTenured:                  (array size * 2 max: 1).   newArray      replaceFrom: firstIndex      to: lastIndex      with: array      startingAt: firstIndex.   array := newArray

_pretenured_add: newObject   "Add a new object at the end of the collection, and returns the object itself"   "((OrderedCollection new add: 42; yourself) add: 43; yourself) asArray >>> #(42 43)"   "Add returns the object itself"   "(OrderedCollection new add: 42) >>> 42"   "You may want to use yourself to return the collection itself"   "(OrderedCollection new add: 42; yourself) class >>> OrderedCollection"   "(OrderedCollection new add: 42; yourself) size >>> 1"   ^ self _pretenured_addLast: newObject

_pretenured_makeRoomAtLast   "Make some empty slots at the end of the array. If we have more than 50% free space, then just move the elements, so that the last 50% of the slots are free, otherwise add new free slots to the end by growing. Precondition: lastIndex = array size"   | tally newFirstIndex newLastIndex |   tally := self size.   tally * 2 >= lastIndex ifTrue: [ ^ self _pretenured_growAtLast ].   tally = 0 ifTrue: [ ^ self resetTo: 1 ].   newLastIndex := lastIndex // 2.   newFirstIndex := newLastIndex - lastIndex + firstIndex.   array      replaceFrom: newFirstIndex      to: newLastIndex      with: array      startingAt: firstIndex.   array from: newLastIndex + 1 to: lastIndex put: nil.   firstIndex := newFirstIndex.   lastIndex := newLastIndex
_pretenured_on: wrappedStream encoding: encoding   ^ self new        on: wrappedStream;        _pretenured_encoding: encoding;        yourself

_pretenured_withRows: anArrayOfArrays columnNames: anArrayOfColumnNames   ^ anArrayOfArrays        _pretenured_ifNotEmpty: [              (self _pretenured_withRows: anArrayOfArrays)                 columnNames: anArrayOfColumnNames;                 yourself ]        ifEmpty: [ self withColumnNames: anArrayOfColumnNames ]
_pretenured_createDataFrame   | df |   df := DataFrame _pretenured_withRows: rows columnNames: columnNames.   self includeRowNames ifTrue: [ df privateRowNames: rowNames ].   ^ df

_pretenured_addLast: newObject   "Add newObject to the end of the receiver. Answer newObject."   lastIndex = array size ifTrue: [ self _pretenured_makeRoomAtLast ].   lastIndex := lastIndex + 1.   ^ array at: lastIndex put: newObject

_pretenured_calculateDataType   | types |   types := Set newTenured.   self do: [ :elem | elem ifNotNil: [ types add: elem class ] ].   types ifNotEmpty: [ :classes |         | result |         result := classes                      inject: classes anyOne                      into: [ :commonSuperclass :each |                         self                            leastCommonSuperclassOf: commonSuperclass                            and: each ].         "If we cannot detect the type, we configure it as Object."         ^ (result withAllSuperclasses includes: String)              ifTrue: [ Object ]              ifFalse: [ result ] ].   ^ UndefinedObject
_pretenured_doWithIndex: elementAndIndexBlock   "Use the new version with consistent naming"   ^ self _pretenured_withIndexDo: elementAndIndexBlock
_pretenured_withRows: anArrayOfArrays   ^ self new _pretenured_initializeRows: anArrayOfArrays

_pretenured_copy   "Answer another instance just like the receiver. Subclasses typically override postCopy; they typically do not override shallowCopy. Copy is a template method in the sense of Design Patterns. So do not override it. Override postCopy instead. Pay attention that normally you should call postCopy of your superclass too."   ^ self shallowCopy postCopy

_pretenured_subclasses   "Answer a Set containing the receiver's subclasses."   <reflection:   'Class structural inspection - Iterating and querying hierarchy'>   ^ subclasses        ifNil: [ #(  ) ]        ifNotNil: [ subclasses _pretenured_copy ]
_pretenured_readStream   ^ self _pretenured_readStreamEncoded: 'utf8'

_pretenured_calculateDataTypes   self asArrayOfColumns _pretenured_doWithIndex: [ :column :i |         self dataTypes            at: (self columnNames at: i)            put: column _pretenured_calculateDataType ]

_pretenured_ifNotEmpty: notEmptyBlock ifEmpty: emptyBlock   "Evaluate emptyBlock if I'm empty, notEmptyBlock otherwise	 If the notEmptyBlock has an argument, eval with the receiver as its argument"   ^ self isEmpty        ifTrue: [ emptyBlock value ]        ifFalse: [ notEmptyBlock _pretenured_cull: self ]
_pretenured_readOnlyRowsWith: aReader   rows := OrderedCollection new.   [ aReader atEnd ] whileFalse: [ rows _pretenured_add: aReader next ]

profileBenchmark   | profiler |   profiler := FiLiP new                  samplingRate: samplingRate;                  profileOn: [ benchmarkClass newTenured run ];                  yourself.   experiment := PathSensitvePretenuring new                    setUpForProfiler: profiler;                    methodProtocol: protocol;                    yourself

readFrom: aFileReference   "Read data frame from a CSV file"   | df |   df := self _pretenured_readFromInternal: aFileReference.   shouldInferTypes ifTrue: [         DataFrameTypeDetector new            columnTypes: columnTypes;            detectTypesAndConvert: df ].   ^ df
recordClassNew: size   ^ recordClass newTenured: size
readRowsWith: aReader   ^ self includeRowNames        ifTrue: [ self readRowsAndRowNamesWith: aReader ]        ifFalse: [ self _pretenured_readOnlyRowsWith: aReader ]
